title: Empirical Study of Label-Space Alignment, Fair-Protocol Domain Adaptation and Edge Deployment for Field Plant Disease Recognition: reproducibility package
description: Code, configuration, data splits, per-run results, conversion-fidelity and edge-latency audits, verified INT8 TFLite models and the manuscript source for the study of PlantVillage-to-field transfer (label-space alignment, five UDA families under a source-validation protocol, Raspberry Pi 4 + Coral Edge TPU deployment). Raw image datasets and PyTorch checkpoints are not included.
